purpose: Exact copy of the frozen Safe-MARL protocol with a documented solar-input completion amendment. No EV window, policy, guard, reward, metric, seed, training artifact, station mapping, or PV proxy setting is changed.

protocol_amendment.status: required execution-data completion after a registered boundary-condition failure
protocol_amendment.reason: One test session connects before the frozen end boundary and truthfully disconnects at 2020-01-01T02:30:00Z. The 2019-only NSRDB input has no observations for the final ten 15-minute replay steps.
protocol_amendment.scope: Add the same NSRDB GOES-CONUS V4.0.0 source at the same latitude, longitude and 15-minute resolution for year 2020. Only the 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z through 2020-01-01T02:15:00Z observations are consumed.
unchanged: ACN test file and half-open connection window
protocol_amendment.interpretation: Results from this configuration must be described as an endpoint-completed amendment to the frozen protocol, not as an unqualified preregistered result.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in, every deployable policy uses only the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture, causal CQR/guard values, and observable present network state. Actual disconnectTime is a hidden replay event and training feedback only after it occurs.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real ACN sessions are mapped to synthetic IEEE-33 feeder stations.

solar_data.note: Solar-resource proxy, not measured rooftop PV.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Synthetic shared-import scarcity, not Caltech's measured feeder limit.

v3.selection_status: The CQR features/hyperparameters, V1 multi-rate guard, hybrid envelope, lower-tail fraction, PV proxy, feeder sensitivity, and primary metric are inherited unchanged from the V3 development decision. Safe-MARL may not alter them.

safe_marl.scope: Station-cap MARL architecture ablation, not a pure EV-level MARL scheduler.

algorithms.mappo: parameter-shared actor with a training-only centralized critic
algorithms.ippo: same parameter-shared actor, action, reward, projection, lower-tail allocator, and safety layer; local critic only

safe_marl.execution_information: Actor receives only causal station-local aggregate observations. The central critic is unavailable after training.
safe_marl.downstream_execution: actor cap fractions -> deterministic shared-feeder projection -> local LowerTailFairMPC -> AC feasibility repair
safe_marl.deadline_guard: CQR plus conservative V1 multi-rate deadline envelope, applied identically to FairFlex-UC, MAPPO, and IPPO

training.checkpoint_rule: Use the final episode checkpoint from every predeclared seed; do not choose a best test seed. Validation is reported as a diagnostic, not a post-hoc selector.

reward.formula: normalized delivered-energy increment + fairness_reward_weight times the concave service-utility increment - raw_feeder_violation_penalty times normalized raw feeder excess - raw_ac_violation_penalty times the raw AC-unsafe indicator
reward.safety_boundary: Executed feasibility remains a hard projection-and-AC-repair constraint, not merely a reward penalty.

safe_marl.forbidden_after_test_acquisition: Do not change data windows, guard settings, CQR settings, actor observations, reward, controller, safety projection/repair, seeds, training budget, checkpoint rule, metrics, station mapping, PV proxy, feeder limit, or statistical endpoint.

statistical_protocol.unit_of_inference: matched calendar day; never individual EV session
statistical_protocol.primary_comparison: each Safe-MAPPO seed and the equally weighted multi-seed mean versus fairflex_uc_hybrid_lower_tail
statistical_protocol.inference: paired calendar-day bootstrap interval and paired sign-flip test for primary P10 (exact through 16 eligible day blocks; otherwise seeded 100,000-draw Monte Carlo). Final multi-seed results use nested seed/day resampling and retain all seed-level rows.
statistical_protocol.minimum_support: daily P10 requires at least 10 sessions; a reported test requires at least 5 eligible days
statistical_protocol.interpretation_limit: This benchmark can compare the two specified architectures under one synthetic scenario; it cannot establish universal superiority over literature with different data, grids, or objectives.
